coverage_notes: CMS Public Notices was checked first; its newest items remained the 2026-10-05 rescissions for Compassionate Care Angels LLC and O.M.K Healthcare Services LLC, both already observed and treated as duplicates. Because no durable 03:45 heartbeat was present on ops/watch-ledger, the recall window was widened from the last durable heartbeat completion at 02:46:21 PT to avoid a coverage gap. Twelve additional targeted searches covered hospital/ED, maternity/labor and delivery, behavioral health, dialysis, oncology, primary care, rural emergency service loss, ambulance/EMS, air-medical, restoration/reopening, and U.S. territories. No new qualifying U.S. or territory healthcare-access development was identified. Stale results, proposals without concrete access effect, non-U.S. events, business-only items, and duplicates were excluded.
